scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:compiler-wasm && npm run build:lsp-wasm
scripts.build:compiler-wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/wasm --target web --out-dir pkg && (command -v wasm-opt >/dev/null 2>&1 && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-reference-types --enable-bulk-memory ../crates/wasm/pkg/solcore_wasm_bg.wasm -o ../crates/wasm/pkg/solcore_wasm_bg.wasm && echo '[build:compiler-wasm] wasm-opt -Oz applied' || echo '[build:compiler-wasm] wasm-opt not found; skipping extra size pass (brew install binaryen for a smaller bundle)')
scripts.build:lsp-wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/lsp --target web --out-dir pkg -- --features wasm && (command -v wasm-opt >/dev/null 2>&1 && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-reference-types --enable-bulk-memory ../crates/lsp/pkg/solcore_lsp_bg.wasm -o ../crates/lsp/pkg/solcore_lsp_bg.wasm && echo '[build:lsp-wasm] wasm-opt -Oz applied' || echo '[build:lsp-wasm] wasm-opt not found; skipping extra size pass (brew install binaryen for a smaller bundle)')
